title: The Lord Reigns; Let the Peoples Tremble

questions.question: The Lord reigns; let the peoples what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 99:1 (ESV): "The Lord reigns; let the peoples tremble!"

questions.question: He sits enthroned upon the cherubim; let the earth do what?
The Lord is great in Zion; he is exalted over all the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 99:2 (ESV): "The Lord is great in Zion; he is exalted over all the peoples."

questions.question: Let them praise your great and awesome name! Holy is what?
The King in his might loves what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 99:4 (ESV): "The King in his might loves justice."

questions.question: You have established equity; you have executed justice and righteousness in whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 99:4 (ESV): "...you have executed justice and righteousness in Jacob."

questions.question: Exalt the Lord our God; worship at his footstool! Holy is what?
Moses and Aaron were among his priests, and Samuel also was among those who called upon his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 99:6 (ESV): "...Samuel also was among those who called upon his name."

questions.question: They called to the Lord, and he did what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 99:6 (ESV): "They called to the Lord, and he answered them."

questions.question: In the pillar of the cloud he spoke to them; they kept his testimonies and the statute that he what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 99:7 (ESV): "...and the statute that he gave them."

questions.question: O Lord our God, you answered them; you were a forgiving God to them, but an avenger of their what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 99:8 (ESV): "...but an avenger of their wrongdoings."

questions.question: Exalt the Lord our God, and worship at his holy what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 99:9 (ESV): "Exalt the Lord our God, and worship at his holy mountain;"

questions.question: For the Lord our God is what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 99:9 (ESV): "for the Lord our God is holy!"

questions.question: Who are the three biblical figures mentioned in this Psalm?
How many times is "Holy is he/the Lord our God" repeated in this Psalm?
questions.explanation: Varses 3, 5, and 9. (In 9 it says "the Lord our God is holy").

key_verse_text: Exalt the Lord our God, and worship at his holy mountain; for the Lord our God is holy!
